hypotheses.directional: A learned directional alignment (cosine(prediction,observed)) feature materially improves changed-role causal memory versus a matched-architecture learner with no directional inputs, at same observation and optimizer budgets.
hypotheses.explicit_contradiction: A second explicit contradiction term in addition to cosine improves post-switch changed-role error versus otherwise identical learned cosine-only control (necessity test).
hypotheses.fixed_comparison: A learned full five-feature gate surpasses the strongest validation-calibrated constant update gain on total and changed-role MSE without losing stable-role retention.
hypotheses.null: No reproducible improvement over stronger competent controls; no contradiction-feature necessity after controlling for cosine.

source.source_mechanics: Identical P69 parent frozen code and dimensions, separately loaded and fail-closed original Git blob, 16D continuous actions and measured consequences, 8 independent target roles, 4 hidden changed relationships, 96 actual history events/world, no future query or role labels at write.
source.selector: FIT and VAL only; reject OOD and negative cohorts at loader boundary, never compute their digests or scores in this gate.
source.custody: Independent per-world SHA256, frozen namespace and seeds, FIT/VAL source digest, source quartile deviation<=.05, target-index heldout balanced accuracy<=.55, changed-role index BA conditional on true target<=.55, future query raw-input duplication zero

fixed.selection: Evaluate all on VAL and select minimum TOTAL VAL MSE; this is stronger than original fixed eta .5 and is an explicitly registered VAL-calibrated control

trained.meaning: P70-equation control trained from fresh P77 FIT, not P70 frozen trained parameters or consumed data

shared.history_access: Only ordered realized factual action and observed outcome; eval query action read after history only
shared.initialization: Each trainable theta_i=(torch.rand(generator=torch.Generator().manual_seed(seed))-0.5)*0.1, truncated to arm feature count; seeds distinct across model seeds and paired first shared features across ablations
shared.factual_update: W <- W + gain * (observed-W a) outer(a), no role/phase/time data

training.checkpoint: lowest TOTAL VAL query-effect MSE only, freeze best theta before any holdout
training.early_stop: No early stopping except error/budget, all 240 updates otherwise

val_success.global_learned_vs_fixed: full5 total MSE<=0.85 * strongest eta_grid VAL total and changed MSE<=0.80*its changed with stable MSE<=1.05*its stable for all 3 seeds; otherwise strict improvement FAIL
val_success.directional_needed: cosine4 changed-role MSE<=0.90*non_directional3 changed-role MSE, stable error<=1.05*non_directional3 stable, all 3 seeds; otherwise directional importance FAIL
val_success.explicit_contradiction_needed: full5 changed-role MSE<=0.95*cosine4 changed-role MSE AND stable MSE<=1.05*cosine4 stable for all 3 seeds, otherwise contradiction-specific claim FAIL
val_success.comparison_to_p70: full5 total VAL MSE <=0.9*p70_four_param total VAL MSE for all 3 seeds, otherwise no superiority to P70 update rule
val_success.eligibility: All arms finite loss, 240 updates, source leakage controls, distinct model initializations, exact 256-state read-before-write and cold-restored bitwise; any failed prerequisite is strict DEV_FAIL, no OOD
val_success.negative: Wrong action-credit and no-direction controls; required wrong credit >=1.2*full5 VAL MSE, otherwise gate FAIL.
val_success.decision: Do not merge direction and contradiction hypothesis outcomes; one may pass while the other fails. Keep complete primary/negative values; no post-result changes.

heldout.first_use: No OOD source generation/scoring unless ALL gates, exact-platform regression and separate project owner first-use authority confirmed.
heldout.if_admitted: 3 independently seeded synthetic OOD cohorts, 3 trained seeds, point gain >=10% against strongest nonprivileged preregistered competitor 9/9, paired 5000-bootstrap lower relative gain>0, cold retention and changed-role recovery separately.
heldout.science: Authored synthetic DEV never SCIENTIFIC_PASS; independent physical/externally qualified intervention source, equal-information fully trained baselines, whole-process cost and approval required.

engineering.focused_tests: Pure causal read-before-write, parity of frozen model full5, three ablations, fixed calibrator, bad input fail closed, same factual state 256, deterministic cold restore, source split isolation
engineering.full_final_regression: Exact candidate SHA Windows+Linux original project test/build plus G4/G5/G7 separately needed; no claim from 0-step runner failures
